node.statement: Let 0 < lambda < 1/2 and let F be a 4-by-4 matrix. If ||P_lambda-F||_{infinity->infinity}<lambda and row_1(F)=row_3(F), then the norm formula from lem-prh-sharpness-family-arithmetic gives ||row_1(P_lambda)-row_1(F)||_1<lambda and ||row_3(F)-row_3(P_lambda)||_1<lambda. The l1 triangle inequality then gives ||row_1(P_lambda)-row_3(P_lambda)||_1<2*lambda, contradicting the equality ||row_1(P_lambda)-row_3(P_lambda)||_1=2*lambda from lem-prh-sharpness-family-arithmetic.
